instrument_title: Will the gold close price be above 4325 USD/t.oz on September 22, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT?

contract_specification.rules_primary: If the close price of the 1-minute candlestick for gold on September 22, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT is above 4325 USD/t.oz, then the market resolves to Yes.

slippage.reference_note: reference = implied NO mid = 1 - YES mid from the same snapshot

fees.model: kalshi_taker: roundup(1 * 0.07 * C * P * (1-P)) @ precision 2 decimals

liquidity_consumed.note: Liquidity taken is the sum of order-book levels actually consumed by this simulated fill.

thesis: Favourite at YES mid 0.985: collecting the residual premium with 0.015 of downside cover per contract.

provenance.note: Official Kalshi public order book (bids only; asks implied by the binary relationship).
